list.text:
Concurrency Control (MVCC):
- UPDATE creates a new row version, old version becomes "dead"
- DELETE marks rows as dead but doesn't remove them
- Dead rows ("dead tuples") accumulate and waste space
VACUUM:
- Removes dead tuples
- Updates visibility map
- Updates table metadata (and planner statistics when run with ANALYZE)
- Prevents transaction ID wraparound
Types of VACUUM

typo.text:
It only free up the disck space for PostgreSQL and does not reclain the space for OS.
Syntax:
VACUUM table_name;
2. VACUUM FULL
This type of vacuuming rewrites the entire table which compact it and recalims the disk space for OS. It frees up more space, it is more resource-intensive and locks the dable during the execution which makes unstable for other options.
Syntax:
VACUUM FULL table_name;
